18983.title_note: 原27字符纯机翻词序；补连字符规范。材料 polyester 属实
18983.desc:
Jumpsuit silhouettes built entirely from openwork fabric answer the coverage question before anyone asks it. This one keeps the structure of a proper one-piece — shoulders, waist, legs — while the open knit does most of the talking. The open back is the loudest single detail: it runs the full width of the torso, so the view from behind is the main event rather than an afterthought.

The polyester knit has enough stretch to pull on without a zipper and enough recovery to keep the pattern sitting flat against the skin. That matters here, because an openwork grid only reads well when it stays under slight tension — loose fabric is what makes this style look careless, and the stretch is what prevents it.

Wear it on its own, or treat it as the base layer under a robe or an open shirt when the evening calls for a slower reveal.

The details, in plain terms:

  • Fabric: Polyester openwork knit
  • Style: One-piece jumpsuit
  • Key detail: Full open back
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Quiet front, loud exit — that is the whole pitch.
18983.short: One-piece openwork jumpsuit in stretch polyester knit, cut with a full-width open back and a pull-on fit for 40–60 kg.
18983.tkd_desc: Open-back jumpsuit in stretch polyester openwork knit with a full-width bare back. Pull-on fit, one size for 40-60 kg, from RoseToys.

19010.title_note: 整串机翻浓缩；pajamas/loungewear/no slip skirt 混词收敛；材质 lace 属实
19010.desc:
The line between loungewear and lingerie mostly comes down to intent, and this jumpsuit sits deliberately on it. The cut is relaxed enough to wear on an ordinary evening — loose through the body, easy over the head — while the sheer lace makes it clear which drawer it belongs in. That double reading is the point: it works as a nightdress and it works as something else entirely.

Lace this sheer behaves more like open mesh, so the jumpsuit stays breathable and light rather than heavy. The silhouette runs long and unstructured, with no wires, no hooks and nothing to adjust beyond the shoulder line. The cut skims instead of hugging, which keeps it firmly on the loungewear side even at full sheer.

Quick specs:

  • Fabric: Sheer lace
  • Style: Jumpsuit with a nightdress drape
  • Colors: As pictured
  • Sizes: M (40–50 kg / 88–110 lbs), L (50–60 kg / 110–132 lbs), XL (60–70 kg / 132–154 lbs)

One piece, two moods — pick the evening first.
19010.short: Sheer lace jumpsuit that doubles as a nightdress, cut loose and easy, in three sizes from M to XL for 40–70 kg.
19010.tkd_desc: Sheer lace jumpsuit with a nightdress feel, cut for lounging in three sizes from M to XL. Recommended 40-70 kg. At RoseToys.

19076.title_note: Uniform seduction bed passion 机翻堆词；open gear=开档误译纠正为 open-crotch
19076.desc:
Uniform-themed lingerie works because it borrows a silhouette everyone already knows, then removes everything that made it office-appropriate. Here the reference is a fitted chiffon set — buttoned-up in spirit, sheer in practice — with an open-crotch cut built into the jumpsuit base so nothing has to come off mid-evening.

Chiffon keeps the whole thing light. It floats rather than clings, holds a shape without any structure of its own, and asks nothing of the wearer but skin. The set reads as a two-piece costume from the front and gives it away the moment it moves. In motion the fabric does the rest — a single layer that travels a half-beat behind the body is the entire special effect.

What you are getting:

  • Fabric: Chiffon
  • Style: Uniform-inspired jumpsuit set
  • Key detail: Open-crotch base
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

A costume that commits to the bit — and to staying on.
19076.short: Uniform-inspired chiffon lingerie set with an open-crotch jumpsuit base and a light easy pull-on fit, one size for 40–60 kg.
19076.tkd_title: Chiffon Open-Crotch Uniform Lingerie Set | RoseToys
19076.tkd_desc: Uniform-style chiffon lingerie set with an open-crotch jumpsuit cut and easy pull-on fit. One size, 40-60 kg, at RoseToys.

19186.title_note: onesie=婴儿连体服误译→teddy；三围参数真实存在，正文展开
19186.desc:
Patent leather makes its argument in one glance: high gloss, hard edges, zero softness pretending to be anything else. This teddy plays that hand honestly. The neckline drops into a deep V that runs well past the sternum, and the glossy shell holds the line of the body instead of draping over it.

Because patent leather does not breathe the way knit fabrics do, the cut is engineered around the fit — three sizes instead of one, each with real measurements. M runs a 60–80 cm bust, L a 70–90 cm bust, and XL an 80–100 cm bust, so the gloss sits smooth instead of pulling at the seams.

The rundown:

  • Fabric: Patent leather
  • Style: One-piece teddy
  • Key detail: Deep-V neckline
  • Sizes: M (bust 60–80 cm, waist 60–70 cm, 40–55 kg), L (bust 70–90 cm, waist 70–80 cm, 50–60 kg), XL (bust 80–100 cm, waist 84–95 cm, 55–65 kg)

When the fabric is this loud, the cut stays simple — and this one knows it.
19186.short: Glossy patent-leather teddy with a deep-V neckline in three measured sizes, with real bust and waist specs for 40–65 kg.
19186.tkd_desc: Deep-V patent leather teddy in three sizes with real bust and waist measurements for 40-65 kg. Shop yours now at RoseToys.

19187.desc:
A slip cut on fine straps is the most direct piece in the lingerie drawer — nothing to untie, nothing to arrange, nothing between the lace and the point. This nightdress keeps that economy and pairs it with a matching thong, so the set is complete straight out of the package.

The lace runs sheer with a repeating floral openwork, light enough to sleep in and open enough to make sleeping a secondary concern. Fine straps sit flat over the shoulder and stay out of the way; the skirt falls straight from a high bust line and moves with the fabric rather than against it.

Four colors cover the whole register — black and white at the ends, red and green for the versions in between.

Specs at a glance:

  • Style: Slip nightdress with thong
  • Colors: Black, white, red, green
  • Sizes: M (40–60 kg / 88–132 lbs), L (60–70 kg / 132–154 lbs), XL (70–80 kg / 154–176 lbs)

One silhouette, four moods, zero fastenings.

19268.desc:
Some sets earn their keep through hardware, and a working zip is the fastest way to make lingerie feel engineered. This uniform set is built around exactly that: a full zip closure down the front of the top, in glossy patent leather, with the rest of the set following the same no-nonsense line.

Three pieces come in the package — the zip-top, a matching panty, and garters that frame the hips without needing stockings to justify them. Worn together the set reads as a complete uniform look; split up, the top holds its own over plain black bottoms. The zip runs the full length of the front, so how far the set opens is a decision rather than an accident.

What the set includes:

  • Fabric: Patent leather
  • Pieces: Top, panties, garters
  • Key detail: Working front zip
  • Color: Black
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Gloss, structure, and a zip that is meant to be heard.
19268.short: Three-piece patent leather uniform set with a working front zip closure: top, panties and garters, one size for 40–60 kg.

19274.new_name: Plush Off-Shoulder Dress with Neck Ring

19274.desc:
Plush changes the register of a lingerie dress completely: where lace is architectural, plush is tactile, and the effect relies on how it feels rather than how it frames. This off-shoulder dress works that angle — deep-pile fabric, bare shoulders, and a matching neck ring that ties the look into something more costume than nightwear.

The off-shoulder line sits where it should without constant tugging, helped by the weight of the pile. Red on plush reads instantly as holiday-adjacent, which makes this the piece to reach for when the calendar turns cold — though nothing about it is limited to December. Four graded sizes keep the pile lying flat, which is the difference between plush that drapes and plush that puckers.

The specifics:

  • Fabric: Polyester plush
  • Pieces: Dress plus matching neck ring
  • Key detail: Off-shoulder cut
  • Color: Red
  • Sizes: S (40–45 kg), M (45–55 kg), L (55–60 kg), XL (60–65 kg)

Soft to the touch, generous in the pile, and unapologetically seasonal.
19274.short: Soft red plush off-shoulder dress with a matching neck ring, in four graded sizes from S to XL for 40–65 kg.
19274.tkd_title: Plush Off-Shoulder Dress with Neck Ring | RoseToys

19276.title_note: three-point 三点式直译剥；chain+bracelet 参数上标题
19276.desc:
Chain hardware gives a black set its spine. This patent leather build leans on that idea: the jumpsuit base is plain glossy black, and the visual weight comes from the metal — chains laid across the chest, plus a matching bracelet that turns the accessory list into part of the outfit.

The zip front is functional rather than decorative, which matters in patent leather — getting into a glossy one-piece is half the battle, and a full zip settles it. The neckline sits open by design, framed by the chain detail rather than covered by it.

Wear the bracelet on the same wrist as the chains and the set reads as one coordinated piece; leave it off and the jumpsuit stands alone.

Fast facts:

  • Fabric: Patent leather
  • Pieces: Jumpsuit, bracelet, chain
  • Key detail: Zip front, open chest line
  • Color: Black
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Black, gloss, and cold metal — the formula does not need more than that.
19276.short: Black patent leather jumpsuit set framed by chest chains, with matching bracelet and a working zip front, one size 40–60 kg.
19276.tkd_title: Chain-Accent Patent Leather Jumpsuit Set | RoseToys

19282.desc:
A top-and-shorts set in light polyester is the honest workhorse of the drawer, and the Chinese-style cut is what lifts this one out of the ordinary: a mandarin collar line, a lace-up front that adjusts by hand, and a silhouette borrowed from traditional sleepwear rather than Western lounge sets.

The lace-up front is the functional heart of it. It opens as far as the evening requires and cinches back without any hardware, which keeps the white fabric lying flat instead of gaping. The shorts are cut simple and mid-length, matching the top in weight so the set moves as one piece.

White polyester keeps the whole thing low-maintenance — light enough for warm rooms, opaque enough to answer the door in.

What the listing includes:

  • Fabric: Polyester
  • Pieces: Top and shorts
  • Style: Chinese-style with lace-up front
  • Color: White
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Traditional lines, bedroom priorities.
19282.short: White Chinese-style two-piece in light woven polyester: adjustable lace-up top and matching shorts, one easy size fit for 40–60 kg.
19282.tkd_desc: White Chinese-style loungewear set with a lace-up top and matching shorts in light polyester. One size, 40-60 kg, at RoseToys.

The pile catches light in a way flat fabric cannot, the red runs deep rather than bright, and the overall effect is closer to a Christmas party dress that happens to be lingerie than the other way round.

The cut is a straight slip with a slit at the leg, sized properly in three steps so the velvet drapes instead of stretching. A matching neck ring comes with the dress and pulls the look together — worn together, the pair reads as one deliberate costume rather than a nightdress with an accessory.

The breakdown:

  • Pieces: Dress plus matching neck ring
  • Key detail: Leg slit, Christmas styling
  • Color: Red
  • Sizes: S (40–45 kg / 88–99 lbs), M (45–55 kg / 99–121 lbs), L (55–65 kg / 121–143 lbs)

Seasonal on the rack, wearable any night it is cold.
